cases.reviewNotes: Custom mesh: calibration bounds, reading direction, bleed and camera clearance checked against provider proof; physical shape remains approximate. All artwork remains below the exact device camera contour.

reviewMethod.calibration: Asymmetric front/back colored bands, border and quarter lines placed in the actual design-safe coordinates. Identical logical designs rendered through server renderProviderPng for Printful and the production browser renderer for local views.
reviewMethod.comparison: Visual review of all 20 contact sheets, original UV-source review for native meshes, independent pixel landmarks for corrected tote/sleeve mappings. This is not an automated pixel-identical or manufacturing approval.
reviewMethod.localProjection: Technical views: production 3D renderer at 600x600 CSS pixels, no automatic rotation or camera tilt; flat photo compositions at their configured native size, before uniform UI framing scale.
limitations: Custom profiles approximate shape and folds; provider photos have different perspective, lighting, shadows and occasional props.
Physical placement variation, trim/seams and print color need physical sample approval.
